Three good-value picks under ₹50,000 all with 16GB RAM and a 512GB SSD:

Acer Aspire 3 (A324-53): about ₹40,990 to ₹49,990 Core i5-1334U, 16GB. Cheapest, good for students.
Acer Aspire 14 AI: about ₹43,999 Snapdragon X (X1-26-100), 16GB. Best battery life.
Lenovo ThinkBook 16: about ₹46,990 Ryzen 5 7535HS, 16GB. Strongest processor and a big 16-inch screen.

If you want the most performance, take the ThinkBook 16. If you want the lowest price, take the Aspire 3.

These prices are rough. They come from one roundup that did not test the laptops itself, last updated Fri 23 Oct 2026. The same laptop can differ by ₹15,000 or more between listings, so check the exact version and live price before buying.
